question: The cost of a washing machine is 10% less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by 55% and that of the TV decreases by 71%, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 6 washing machines and 3 TVs?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of TV cost to WM cost = 100 : 90 = 10 : 9

Initial weighted value = (6 × 9) + (3 × 10) = 54 + 30 = 84 parts

Net change in parts = (54 × 55%) − (30 × 71%) = 29.7 − 21.3 = 8.4 parts

% Change = (Net change ÷ Initial value) × 100 = (8.4 ÷ 84) × 100 = 10%

Since the result is positive, it is an increase.

**∴ Answer = Increase by 10%**
